target.name: Nuveen Ohio Quality Municipal Income Fund

listed_quote.quote: The Boards of Trustees of Nuveen Ohio Quality Municipal Income Fund (NYSE: NUO), Nuveen Georgia Quality Municipal Income Fund (NYSE: NKG), and Nuveen Municipal Credit Income Fund (NYSE: NZF) have approved a proposal to reorganize the funds.

announcement.quote: The proposed reorganizations, if approved by shareholders, would combine NUO and NKG into NZF.

deals.notes: Shareholders approved the NUO-NZF merger at the 2023-02-08 meeting (8-K 0001193125-23-030426: 'approved the proposed merger between NUO and NZF'), but no excerpted filing states it was completed. Outcome left null.

target.name: Nuveen Georgia Quality Municipal Income Fund

listed_quote.quote: The Boards of Trustees of Nuveen Ohio Quality Municipal Income Fund (NYSE: NUO), Nuveen Georgia Quality Municipal Income Fund (NYSE: NKG), and Nuveen Municipal Credit Income Fund (NYSE: NZF) have approved a proposal to reorganize the funds.

announcement.quote: The proposed reorganizations, if approved by shareholders, would combine NUO and NKG into NZF.

deals.notes: 8-K 0001193125-23-030426 (2023-02-10) says NKG adjourned its meeting on the merger proposal to solicit further proxies. No later excerpted filing states how the NKG-NZF merger ended, so outcome is null.
